app.setup.title_default.why: Plain headline naming the missing state, mirrors Apple ContentUnavailableView register.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged wording (无法确认) distinguishes this from the plain not-yet-on state above.

app.setup.detail_default.s: 网站一旦开启防护，就无法再劫持你的点按。
app.setup.detail_default.back: Once a site turns on protection, it can no longer hijack your presses.
app.setup.detail_default.why: 点按 covers tap and click together (Apple's own term); states the payoff plainly, not as a slogan.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: 这次没能从 Safari 得到答复；如果你已经启用扩展，本应用会自动发现。
app.setup.detail_failed.back: This time failed to get a reply from Safari; if you have already enabled the extension, this app will automatically discover it.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: No jargon or error code; reassures the person there is nothing to come back and refresh.

app.setup.open_button.s: 打开 Safari 扩展设置
app.setup.open_button.why: Verb plus object naming the exact destination; 扩展 is Apple's own term, works on both screens it appears on.

app.welcome.heading.why: Standard Apple first-launch phrasing (欢迎使用 <App>); the one place allowed a warmer register.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Short concrete noun naming the trick, no marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: 页面上可能盖着一层看不见的东西，你点的不是你以为点的地方。
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: The page may have an invisible thing covering it; what you tap is not where you thought you tapped.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person experiences, not the DOM mechanism underneath.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: 掉包 (switched out) is a plain, vivid term for the swap, not technical jargon.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: 有些网页会在你按下和松开之间，偷偷换掉链接指向的地方。
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some pages secretly change where the link points, between your press and release.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Plain description of the timing trick, avoids the words 'event' or 'DOM'.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Plain concrete noun; avoided a cuter phrase (an uninvited-guest pun) that would read as marketing.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: 防护开启后，新标签页只会打开你点的那个目的地，不会额外夹带别的。
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: Once protection is on, a new tab only opens the destination you pressed, without smuggling anything extra alongside.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Framed as a promise per the brief; 目的地 keeps the destination term consistent across the file.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Names the rule-list feature: everything gets tracked, not just what gets caught.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: 防护看到的每个目的地都会单独列出，你可以按本站或所有网站分别选择放行或拦截。
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination the protection sees is listed separately; you can choose to let through or block it, by this site or by all sites.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Uses the 本站/所有网站 scope pair and 放行/拦截 verdict pair consistently with the rest of the file.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Names the per-site activation mechanism concretely.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: 在某个网站上点一下 Safari 工具栏里的 Undirect 图标，就能为这个网站开启防护。
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Tap the Undirect icon in the Safari toolbar on a site once, and protection turns on for that site.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: Concrete mechanism: names the toolbar button and its effect, matches the toolbar_button vocabulary entry.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Compact noun phrase for the 'guarded site' vocabulary term; fits a narrow sidebar column.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own official zh-Hans term for Settings, per house instruction to defer to Apple's terms.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Names the everywhere-scope filter; pairs with 按网站 below as a contrasting sidebar pair.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Clear opposite of 所有网站 when the two sit side by side in the sidebar.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.back: Not yet connected to the extension
app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: Wiring/first-contact wording (尚未连接), distinct from the content-empty wording used below.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: 在 Safari 里打开一个网页，这里就会显示内容。
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open a webpage in Safari, and this will show content.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: States the simple fix in one short sentence, no setting to change.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Short content-empty title, contrasts with the connection-state wording above it.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: 只有你亲自允许或拦截过某个目的地，它才会出现在这里。
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: Only once you have personally allowed or blocked a destination will it appear here.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains that seeing a destination is not enough; a decision has to be made. Reuses 目的地.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.s: 累计已拦截 %lld 次劫持
app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: %lld kept verbatim; Chinese has only one plural category, so this single string serves every count via the stringsdict's 'other' form.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: Pairs with 已放行 as a clear opposite; same root reused for the action verb below.

app.rules.row.state_allowed.why: 放行 is the ordinary Chinese security-app term for letting something through; clear opposite of 已拦截.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Bare verb form, sharing its root with the state word 已放行 so the two read as the same action.

app.rules.row.action_block.why: Bare verb form, sharing its root with 已拦截.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: 选择放行还是拦截此目的地
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: Choose whether to let through or block this destination
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Describes the control under the pointer, per the Apple .help tooltip convention.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Common Apple UI phrase for clearing an override back to the default policy.

app.watched.empty.title.back: Not yet turned on for any site
app.watched.empty.title.why: States plainly that no site has guarding switched on.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: 在爱乱跳转的网站上点一下 Safari 工具栏的 Undirect 图标，即可开启防护。
app.watched.empty.detail.back: On a site prone to random redirects, tap the Undirect icon in the Safari toolbar to turn on protection.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Concrete instruction naming the toolbar button, matching the welcome-sheet feature wording.

app.watched.footer.s: 网站只能通过 Safari 工具栏里的图标添加，这里无法新增。
app.watched.footer.back: Sites can only be added via the icon in the Safari toolbar; adding here is not possible.
app.watched.footer.why: Clarifies this screen can remove but not add, per the brief.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Plain read-only state word, distinct from the Mac-only action button below.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb for a small trailing button; distinct concept from the block/allow verdict pair.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.back: Turn off protection for this site
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes the button's action per the Apple .help tooltip convention.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: Core vocabulary term for 'guard', used as the master switch's own label.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state word, reused for more than one setting on this screen as instructed.

app.settings.state_off.why: Generic off-state counterpart to 开启.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Introduces the watched-sites-vs-everywhere choice as a scope heading.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's own point of view, not as a technical mode name, per the brief.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Names the automatic every-site mode; reuses the same term as the 所有网站/本站 scope pair.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Names the optional on-page banner feature, matches the 'note in the page' vocabulary entry.

app.settings.policy_heading.back: Default handling when there is no rule
app.settings.policy_heading.why: Frames the heading explicitly as the fallback for destinations without their own rule.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short imperative picker option, shares the 拦截 root with the rest of the file.

app.settings.policy_allow.why: Opposite picker option, shares the 放行 root.

ext.meta.name.why: Brand name kept as-is, matching app.nav.app_title.

ext.meta.description.s: 拦截网页偷走你的点按，跳到你没打算去的地方。
ext.meta.description.back: Blocks webpages from stealing your press and jumping somewhere you did not intend to go.
ext.meta.description.why: One plain sentence for a first-time reader in Safari's extension list, no jargon about how the trick works.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback uses the product's own name since there is no site name available to show instead.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.back: Protection for this site is already on
ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the current on-state as the toolbar icon's accessible tooltip text.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.s: 此网站的防护未开启，点一下即可开启
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.back: Protection for this site is not on; tap once to turn it on
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as tooltip and call-to-action, per the brief: pressing the icon here is what turns it on.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.s: 当前页面没有可防护的网站
ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.back: The current page has no site that can be protected
ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Brief explanation that there is nothing to guard on this tab.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Short headline for the empty state, sits beside a small icon.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: 打开一个网站后，点这里的图标即可为它开启防护。
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: After opening a site, tap the icon here to turn on protection for it.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: '这里' keeps the self-reference to the toolbar button the popup hangs off of, as the brief's notes ask.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: 开启或关闭本网站的防护
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: Turn this site's protection on or off
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader-only label describing the switch's function, since the visible row already shows the site name.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.back: No page that can be protected
ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Brief reason the per-site switch is disabled: there is no actual page here.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.s: 已设置为在所有网站开启防护
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.back: Already set to turn on protection on every site
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the switch is redundant because Settings already runs the guard everywhere; reuses 所有网站.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.s: 防护已在设置中整体关闭
ext.popup.watch_master_off.back: Protection has been turned off entirely in Settings
ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Clarifies the disabling reason is the master switch, not anything about this particular site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: 本网站防护已开启，关闭后页面会重新加载
ext.popup.watch_on.back: This site's protection is on; turning it off will reload the page
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms the state and warns of the reload consequence in one sentence, per the brief.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: 本网站防护已关闭，开启后页面会重新加载
ext.popup.watch_off.back: This site's protection is off; turning it on will reload the page
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Mirrors watch_on's sentence shape so the two read as a clear before/after pair.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Short two-character heading distinct from the site-wide rules, sits beside the trailing count badge.

ext.popup.page_off.s: 本站未开启防护，暂无记录
ext.popup.page_off.back: Protection not on for this site; nothing recorded yet
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22; kept close in tone to page_quiet per the brief's own note.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: 这个页面还没有向外跳转过
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: This page has not jumped outward yet
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: Plain statement that nothing has reached for another site so far on this tab.

ext.popup.page_empty.s: 暂时没有可显示的内容
ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key, treated as a near-synonym of page_quiet per the brief, worded around an empty list.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Chinese has no singular form, so this string is identical to stopped_other; $COUNT$ is blocked-only, on this page.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Identical to stopped_one: Chinese collapses the English singular/plural pair into one form.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: 记录 (recorded) distinguishes this broader total from 拦截 (blocked-only) above; identical across count per Chinese grammar.

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Identical to seen_one; Chinese has no plural inflection.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse fragment meant to sit among other comma-joined fragments in one row's detail line; identical for any count.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Identical to tries_one; Chinese has no plural inflection.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Works as the lead-in half of the 'Heading: fix name' pattern the code concatenates.

ext.state.blocked.why: Matches app.rules.row.state_blocked so the word reads the same across app and extension.

ext.state.removed.why: Distinct from the allow/block pair since a local trap has no destination to rule on; states it was removed.

ext.scope.here.why: Fragment meant to follow a verdict word with a code-inserted space, e.g. 已拦截 仅本站; reads as a compact badge chunk rather than a full sentence.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Same term used throughout the file for the everywhere scope; follows a verdict word as a badge chunk.

ext.scope.default.why: Short adverbial fragment following a verdict word, e.g. 已拦截 默认, meaning no explicit rule was set.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Standalone menu option (not concatenated), pairs with 所有网站放行 as scope-explicit siblings.

ext.action.allow_everywhere.why: Everywhere-scoped counterpart to 本站放行.

ext.action.block_here.why: Standalone menu option, pairs with 所有网站拦截.

ext.action.block_everywhere.why: Everywhere-scoped counterpart to 本站拦截.

ext.popup.policy_heading.back: How to handle when there is no rule
ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Popup-side counterpart to app.settings.policy_heading, same underlying concept.

ext.policy.block.why: Same string as app.settings.policy_block so the two surfaces read identically.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: 此页面的安全策略挡住了部分防护脚本，这里的防护并不完整。
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's security policy blocked part of the protection script; protection here is not complete.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Names the limitation as belonging to this one page, plain and non-alarming, no error code or CSP jargon.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Concrete tag for an invisible clickable element, short enough to sit in a comma-joined tag list.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than 隐形点击陷阱 (not specifically clickable), per the brief's own distinction.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a page-dispatched fake click, distinct from a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Names a window.open()-triggered pop-up as a short tag.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Short tag naming the timing of the swap, between press and release.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Ties the tag to the back gesture specifically, distinct from the plain redirect tag below.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Core same-tab redirect trick, named as a short tag for the comma-joined list.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Describes the tab-under trick concretely and briefly.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the earliest, strongest kind of block, distinct from the page-script-caught kinds above.

ext.reason.way_back.s: 地址里带着返回原站的路径
ext.reason.way_back.back: The address carries a path back to the original site
ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains the 'way back' signal that reads as a legitimate round-trip rather than a hijack.

ext.reason.sized.why: Short footnote naming why a sized window reads as intentional rather than a bare hijack tab.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Very short footnote (15-25 char budget); 蹭 is a plain, vivid verb for riding along on someone else's action.

ext.reason.default_allow.back: No rule, let through by default
ext.reason.default_allow.why: Terse footnote explaining the fallback to the default policy.

ext.reason.own_code.back: Opened by this site's own code

ext.popup.rules_link.why: Single word reused across the nav row, the screen's own header, and the back-button accessibility label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Names where the chevron-only back button goes, meaningful heard aloud with no visual context.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Consistent with app.rules.grouping.everywhere and the scope vocabulary term used throughout.

ext.rules.empty.why: Terse single-row list placeholder, as short as the position needs.

ext.action.allow.why: Bare verb; scope is already fixed by which section of the Rules screen the row sits in.

ext.action.block.why: Bare verb counterpart to 放行.

ext.action.clear.why: Names removing the rule itself; reads as the same action as app.rules.row.use_default though phrased from the opposite angle (delete vs. restore).

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Same Apple term as app.nav.settings; separate translation unit, reads identically to the user.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Matches app.settings.guard_toggle; used both as the visible row text and the switch's sr-only label.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: State label for the master guard switch specifically.

ext.settings.guard_off.why: Opposite state label, counterpart to 已开启.

ext.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Matches app.settings.mode_everywhere and the scope vocabulary term.

ext.action.report.why: Plain verb-plus-object naming the action of opening a pre-filled issue report.
